name: South Lane Mental Health- 6th St

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single-story commercial building with a dark roof and a lighter central roof section|A small paved parking lot is located on one side of the building with marked spaces, including an accessible space|The building occupies a street corner with paved streets on two sides|Multiple vehicles are parked in the lot and along the street|The left side of the building is against another building.

alpha.desc: The front of the building shows a single-story commercial structure facing the street|Windows and entry openings are present along the facade|Street frontage and an intersection are immediately adjacent|Vehicles are parked along the curb and in the side lot|Sidewalk space runs along the building edge.

bravo.desc: The left side of the building shows the side elevation and the small paved parking lot to the rear of the property|Multiple vehicles occupy the lot|Street pavement wraps around the corner of the property|The building sits close to the street with limited setback.

charlie.desc: The rear of the building shows the back facing the parking lot|Multiple vehicles are parked in marked spaces|Street frontage continues along one side|Rooftop equipment is visible on the roof|The lot is compact and bordered by streets on two sides and a building on another.

delta.desc: The right side of the building shows the street-facing elevation at the corner|Vehicles are parked along the curb and in the adjacent lot|The intersection and street pavement wrap around the building|The structure sits close to both street frontages.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from N 6th St into a small paved parking lot on one side of the building, with additional curb parking along the street. The structure is a single-story commercial building on a street corner. Circulation space around the building is limited by adjacent streets and neighboring buildings. The site is in a downtown commercial area.
clarifications: Which door is the primary public entrance? Is the side parking lot the only on-site vehicle access, or is there a rear or alley entrance? Are there designated fire lanes or restricted parking zones at the corner? Do any gates or barriers control the parking lot? Is pedestrian access available from both street frontages?
